entries.text: Males 20 years old and up are to be mustered and enrolled for military service.
Only those who are able-bodied for war are to be enrolled for armed service.
Military leaders or captains to be appointed over divisions of armed forces.
Military chain of authority is to be established --Officers over thousands, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens.
Military aides assigned to aid officers with their equipment and in battle.
Military advisors or counselors are to be used in conducting war.

A need to establish different branches of the armed forces with different leaders: captains of the guard (2 Chron. 12:10); captains of chariots and captains of the cavalry (2 Chron. 8:9); chief of those armed with bows (1 Chron. 12:2-3); chief of the infantry (
A chief of captains, or general, is to be established over the armed forces; one who has demonstrated his military ability.
